purpose: Freeze the minimum scientifically meaningful Paper 1 claim without requiring every memory head to pass and without allowing an RS-only or single-memory-head system to count as success.

head_pass_definition.selector: The component-specific grouped/cross-fitted selector must be nondegenerate and improve on the named simple baseline under its frozen prospective suitability estimand; no single arbitrary BA threshold can override the full evidence.
head_pass_definition.candidate_support: The public candidate surface must contain both applicable and non-applicable or abstention cases across real connected groups; candidate presence alone is not a pass.
head_pass_definition.verified_function: When the learned policy requests the component, source-aware offline review must observe a nonzero and reproducible component-attributable contribution; generator telemetry is insufficient.
head_pass_definition.same_stack_outcome: Against the component-off and other frozen same-stack baselines, the learned component must show useful conditional behavior without a material Quality or Risk regression; Function, Quality, Risk, and Cost remain separate.
head_pass_definition.responsibility: A head cannot fail because another component's response act was fixed incorrectly; interaction slices must separate selector, retrieval, joint planning, generator realization, and measurement responsibility.

failed_head_behavior.at_most_one_failed_memory_head: fixed OFF in the qualified learned deployment policy and reported as a component limitation
failed_head_behavior.two_or_more_failed_memory_heads: Paper 1 primary PM claim fails even if RS passes
failed_head_behavior.action_space_reporting: Keep the conceptual 16-action space and report structural projections; do not delete the failed component from the design or rewrite the project as a smaller action space.

current_evidence_not_a_final_result.RS: selector evidence exists; compatible full learned deployment and closure-aware response-act evaluation remain incomplete
current_evidence_not_a_final_result.MP: candidate surface exists; formal label/transport and end-to-end evidence remain incomplete
current_evidence_not_a_final_result.MS: teacher-suitability selector signal exists; RS-fixed-on verified Function is 0/7 and therefore no end-to-end pass
current_evidence_not_a_final_result.ME: typed surface exists but is sparse; no current formal pass
current_evidence_not_a_final_result.reason: Fewer than two memory heads currently have complete selector plus verified-Function plus same-stack outcome support.

forbidden_reinterpretations: RS plus MS alone automatically counts as the complete minimum system
one memory head pass is enough for the Paper 1 primary claim
a failed memory head is removed from the conceptual design or the 16 requested actions
candidate coverage or OOF discrimination alone counts as a head pass
Quality wins with zero verified Function count as memory benefit
cost changes a component suitability label
